page.overview:
Who is Bipsom?

Link can first encounter Bipsom inside Bipin's & Blossom's House, which is a location in both Horon Village in and Lynna City in . Bipsom is first seen as an infant in the arms of his mother, Blossom, with his father, Bipin, running around back and forth nearby. If Link speaks to Blossom, she explains that she is having trouble thinking of a name for her baby and asks Link if he can think of one. Link can say "No" to modify the name. Once Link says "Yes," Blossom agrees to call him that name and tells Link to visit them anytime. If Link speaks to Blossom again, she expresses hope that her son will grow up strong and healthy like Link. If Link speaks to Bipin after naming his son, he remarks that it is a fine name and that he hopes he will grow up to be a fine child. The name that Link gives the baby may affect his personality and life path. If Link visits the family to complete each step of their story line, their son can develop into a child over the course of the game and continue to grow into adulthood throughout the following Linked Game or Hero's Secret.

After Link collects two Essences and has named Bipin's and Blossom's son, Link can revisit the family and talk to Blossom to find that their son is ill and needs a doctor. Blossom explains that they do not have enough Rupees to see a doctor and asks if Link would lend them some. If Link says "Yes," Blossom asks him how much he will lend them. If Link chooses an amount of Rupees that is higher than what he currently has, then Blossom will tell him that he does not have enough. If Link gives Blossom 1 Rupee, she says that his sympathy is enough. If Link gives her 10 Rupees, she thanks him and says she will have to find a way to earn the rest of the Rupees. If Link gives her 50 Rupees, she thanks him and says that it should be just enough. If Link gives her 150 Rupees, she thanks him and calls him a "true samaritan." If Link leaves and re-enters the house and speaks to Blossom, she thanks him again and says that she can take her baby to the doctor now. The amount of Rupees Link gives can affect the outcome of the child's personality and life path. Once Link has walked around the Overworld for at least 8 screens, he can return to Blossom to find that the baby is no longer ill.

After Link has collected four Essences and has learned that the baby is no longer sick, he can speak to Blossom to find that the baby is not sleeping enough. Blossom asks Link how she can get him to sleep. If Link speaks to her afterward, she comments about how her son is a "darling baby." The decision that Link chooses here affects the outcome of the child's personality and life path.
